grid_law: Enumerate (u,v) lexicographically with a1=47*u and a3=47*v; derive a2,a4,a6 from the same tangent construction as the rank-one replacement panel
rank_method: For every curve, Simon two-descent with known Q and limbigprime=0; if completed upper bound <=1, run Sage proof-enabled PARI rank with use_database=False and only_use_mwrank=True
status_law: Retain all nine grid cells, including rank intervals, errors, and timeouts; a certified rank-one witness requires matching completed Simon 1-1 bounds and proof-enabled exact rank one
selection: first certified rank-one cell in lexicographic (u,v) order, without stopping the grid
